title: 第23章 世间巨震十多位绝顶天帝兵压道一圣地第24章 超天帝又怎样诡异力量再现
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
命令传达，魏族上下震动。
发生什么恐怖大事了？
族长竟然召集族内所有长老集合！
这是从未有过的事情！
族内的长老不敢犹豫，快速赶往集合。
不愧是自上古时代传承下来的超古世族。
魏族实力当真恐怖！
天帝数量超过了十位还多！
并且多数都在天帝境沉淀已久，修到了天帝境后期巅峰。
全是绝顶天帝！
“魏江死了，你们随我一起杀上道一圣地，看看到底是谁杀死了我的弟弟！”
魏族族长立于山峰之巅，声音冰冷的对一众长老说道。
若是只有魏武死了。
他不好发作。
没法带领一众长老杀上道一圣地。
魏武是私生子。
不被魏族的族人接受。
而魏江不一样。
魏江是他亲弟弟，血脉纯正的魏族人。
替魏江报仇。

无论他弄出多大阵仗，多大动静都不为过！
“什么！
？”
“谁这么大的胆子？！”
一众长老听到魏江被人杀死后，皆心中一惊。
随后他们就暴怒如雷。
杀了他们魏族族长的亲弟弟。
这是一点也没把他们魏族放在眼中啊！
他们目光阴冷。
说什么也要找到这个凶手，将其千刀万剐掉！
无论是上古时代。
还是远古时代。
他们魏族始终屹立至高。
从未有人，有势力敢挑衅他们魏族。
如今，有人竟然杀了他们族长亲弟弟。
这已经不是挑衅。
而是宣战了！
content_en:
The order was conveyed, and the Wei clan was shaken up and down.
What terrible thing happened?
The clan leader actually summoned all the elders in the clan to gather!
This has never happened before!
The elders of the clan did not dare to hesitate and rushed to gather quickly.
It is worthy of being an ultra-ancient family that has been inherited from ancient times.
The strength of the Wei clan is truly terrifying!
The number of Heavenly Emperors exceeds ten!
And most of them have been in the Heavenly Emperor Realm for a long time and have reached the peak of the late Heavenly Emperor Realm.
They are all supreme emperors!
"Wei Jiang is dead. Come with me to Daoyi Holy Land to find out who killed my brother!"
The leader of the Wei clan stood on the top of the mountain and said to the elders in a cold voice.
If only Wei Wu died.
It's not easy for him to have seizures.
There is no way to lead a group of elders to kill Dao Yi Holy Land.
Wei Wu was an illegitimate son.
Not accepted by the Wei clan.
But Wei Jiang is different.
Wei Jiang is his younger brother, a member of the Wei clan with pure blood.
Revenge for Wei Jiang.
No matter how big a battle or noise he makes, it's never too big!
"What!
? "
"Who is so brave?!"
All the elders were shocked when they heard that Wei Jiang had been killed.
Then they became furious.
Kill the brother of their Wei clan leader.
This does not take the Wei clan into consideration at all!
Their eyes were cold.
No matter what, we must find this murderer and cut him into pieces!
Regardless of ancient times.
It’s still ancient times.
Their Wei clan has always stood tall.
No one or force has ever dared to provoke the Wei clan.
Now, someone actually killed the brother of their clan leader.
This is no longer a provocation.
Instead, war was declared!
